name: happy-google-analytics-tools
description: Dev tools for the Dataform project (the project itself lives one folder up, Dataform does not allow a package.json there when dataformCoreVersion is in workflow_settings.yaml)
author: Francisco Lucas / Nikola Wissenklaus / Chico

scripts.validate:sql: npm run compile:json && python validate_sql.py out/compiled.json
scripts.check: npm run test:udfs && npm run validate:sql
scripts.catalog: npm run compile:json && node generate_catalog.js out/compiled.json ../docs/catalog.md
